kernel_method.effect_models: data/models/team_strength.joblib models conv_no_spread and drive_no_spread (ratings without the spread, fitted on 2012 to 2023): the exact game has no spread, so the whole effect of the ratings is used
kernel_method.fourth_down_rule_for_drive_points: field goal if P(make) >= 0.6, else go on fourth and 1 from the own 40 on, else punt
kernel_method.kicking: field goals, punts, kickoffs and tries league average for both teams
